name: usability-discovery-guide
description: A lightweight feature discovery guide that helps beginner VS Code users find common tools such as the Command Palette, Settings, Extensions, and Terminal.

usabilityDiscoveryGuide.showBeginnerTips.description: Show beginner-oriented tips in the feature discovery guide.

walkthroughs.title: Discover VS Code Features
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to find common VS Code features through the Command Palette, Settings UI, Extensions view, and integrated Terminal.

steps.title: Use the Command Palette
steps.description: Open the Command Palette with Cmd+Shift+P on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows/Linux. The Command Palette helps users discover actions without memorizing menu locations.

steps.title: Find Settings
steps.description: Use the Settings UI to search for editor configuration options. This improves discoverability compared with editing JSON settings manually.

steps.title: Explore Extensions
steps.description: Use the Extensions view to add language support, themes, debuggers, and other workflow features without modifying the core editor.

steps.title: Use the Integrated Terminal
steps.description: Open the integrated terminal to run commands without leaving VS Code.
